select * from ( select a.*, b.tips_value as risk_type from stt_scene a left join stt_scene_tips b on a.scene_id = b.scene_id and b.dict_code = 'RISK_TYPE' and b.tips_value = '03' where a.scene_name like concat('%',IFNULL(#{sceneStr, jdbcType=VARCHAR},''),'%') or a.scene_id like concat('%',IFNULL(#{sceneStr, jdbcType=VARCHAR},''),'%') ) r
r.risk_type = '03' and r.is_tmpl = '02'
limit 0,50
